_meta.method: Downloaded the Charity Commission for England and Wales full-register JSON bulk extract (https://ccewuksprdoneregsadata1.blob.core.windows.net/data/json/publicextract.charity.zip, HTTP 200, 56.9 MB zip, date_of_extract 2026-10-11, 398681 rows incl. linked charities) and https://ccewuksprdoneregsadata1.blob.core.windows.net/data/json/publicextract.charity_other_names.zip (HTTP 200, 175062 rows); streamed the JSON from the zips without extracting, indexed by registered_charity_number. Main record = linked_charity_number 0; rows with linked_charity_number > 0 are linked (subsidiary) charities sharing the number. The JSON spells the registration status as "Registered"/"Removed" (R/RM in the text extract). other_names = the main record's rows in charity_other_names ("Previous name"/"Working name"; the extract has no separate trading-name type). Both U6 values are plain charity numbers and each has a main record, so no name search was needed. Same fetcher as U2 (scripts copied from u2fetch/cc). http is the bulk-file fetch status; found is from the file.
